items.title: How ArisGlobal scaled generative AI inference on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: ArisGlobal runs NavaX, its life-sciences AI engine, on Amazon Bedrock. By caching the shared prompt prefix instead of each per-case document, ArisGlobal cut effective input cost by about 50% and overall monthly inference spend by about 40%, while onboarding more tenants without proportional cost growth.
items.creator: Shubham Gupta
